notes.title: Bouncy Bob 2 is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33265723/9f336c5a776d58b9f6f06723abc29055e6778648.png[/img]

Bouncy Bob 2 is a crazy couch co-op game for up to 4 players. Choose one of 12 different characters. Customize your color and get ready for the ultimate bouncy bobbing.

Bouncy Bob 2 is the continuation of top-rated(95% of positive reviews) Bouncy Bob. Fight with zombies and your friends, prove who is the best! :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1117330/Bouncy_Bob_Episode_2

notes.title: Celebrating 100 years of Polish independence
notes.notes:
This year is special for all Poles. Steam wanted to celebrate with us, so they organized a 'Polish Developer Sale" sale for the 100th anniversary of regaining independence by Poland.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30160519/3b103dc38bede2eab5d01bb811185117a2c753c5.jpg[/img]

Therefore, you can purchase many games from Polish developers at promotional prices.

[h1]Offer ends Friday at 10am Pacific Time.[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/680620/Bouncy_Bob/

[h1]Thank you for your support![/h1]

Yours,
Ultimate Games Team
